answer: Each agent must rent a unique attested enclave slot at 8 POA per epoch, and a slot cannot be reassigned for 30 epochs. An ivory-signed hardware quote binds one key to one slot, so 1,000 fakes pay 8,000 POA every epoch and 240,000 over the lock, while an honest user rents one slot for 8. Verifiers re-check 6% of quotes each epoch; a forged quote burns 80% of the rent. Even at the summit of a nebula of cheap identities, cost grows linearly with N.
